missing_values: Empty CSV numeric cells and visible N/A; never replaced by zero or later sessions.

statistics.sampling_unit: device/run group; exactly one test observation per group
statistics.macro_f1: unweighted mean over all fixed valid labels; zero_division=0
statistics.bootstrap_interval: unstratified paired group percentile interval; numpy linear quantiles
statistics.pairing: The same group-index draws are reused for all methods, conditions and repeats of a dataset.
statistics.repeat_policy: Repeat 1 is primary. Repeats 2/3 and min/max report session variation; no pooling as extra samples.
statistics.semantic_failure_policy: Pre-score failure-reporting amendment: keep every planned terminal outcome; semantic failures have N/A classification metrics and no partial labels are scored. Never substitute a later repeat for primary repeat 1.
statistics.multiple_comparisons: All prespecified pairs reported without significance selection; intervals are unadjusted descriptive intervals, not familywise tests.
statistics.ci_scope: Descriptive 95% intervals conditional on the fixed selected devices/runs and observed grouped-session predictions. Resampling devices/runs does not rerun the model or capture dependence induced by a shared batch, model/session variability, selection bias, or benchmark contamination. They are not full independent-experiment intervals.
statistics.study_scope: Exploratory convenience sample; no confirmatory power calculation or population representativeness claim.
